span.p:
106 MB overlay, 254 bundled files:
251 framework assemblies, every one
Authenticode-signed and verified intact,
plus ThreatInvaders.dll — 4,929 lines
of C# and completely clean

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10 MB native host,
statically linked CoreCLR

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
the implant. The JIT prestub is patched:
once the JIT has emitted native code it
compares the method name — one literal,
four 64-bit FNV-ish hashes — and swaps in
a replacement address.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GetMachineGuid
copy the 16-byte GUID into
the implant's key slot

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ReplaceHighscores
for each downloaded row:
first 4 bytes of the name
XOR the 32-bit score
== 'cmd:' ?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LaunchUpdate
overwrite the 260-byte path
and 1024-byte argument buffers,
then call the original,
which does Process.Start

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
on a match: decrypt the comment in
place, skip 4 bytes, split on ';'
into two implant globals

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: encrypt the captured stdout, same keystream

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EncodeFeedbackBuffer fills the
4096-byte telemetry buffer: either the
key leak (length tag 0x2010) or the
command output (bit 0x4000 set)
